_meta.purpose: Shared brand/design SSOT across BOTH Elacity products: the production dApp (elacity-web v4.4.0, MUI theme) and the runtime marketplace-content shell (vanilla CSS :root vars). One source, two emitters — so the look converges WITHOUT coupling code (elacity-web stays MUI, the runtime stays vanilla/auditable). Step 7 of the 2026-06-24 council audit.
_meta.rule: BRAND tokens (color/effect) are donated FROM elacity-web (the production identity). STRUCTURAL tokens (space/radius/type/motion/elevation) are owned BY the runtime shell — its CSS-var contract is the more disciplined core (council finding: Devon). Neither product imports the other's code.
